name: QA hooks
description: QA only: the public hooks of docs/design/public-hooks.md, used as a mod author would, part by part. Each file trigger in <dataDir>/files (JSON) runs one call and writes <trigger>.out.json with {ok, value} or {ok: false, error}: attach {ref, value, shared?}, attached {ref}, list {type, where?}, decorate {id, subject?, spec}, redact {spec} (ui.content.redact), filter {spec}, filter-on {id, window?}, filter-off {id}, starter {spec} (ui.newThread.starter), attach-source {spec, attachments} (ui.composer.attachSource), update {id, patch}, dispose {id}, rule {kind, presentation?, spec} (any declaration), parts {presentation, slot?}, status {spec, run?} (run: true records its clicks), runs {}, settings-section {spec}, theme {spec} (ui.theme.add), override {spec} (ctx.graph.override), override-restore {id}, invoke-all {calls, reason?} (ctx.graph.invokeAll), link-route {spec, run?} (ui.links.route; run: true records the links it opens to runs), sidebar-order {spec}, sidebar-section {spec, action?}, choices {of, spec, add?}, send {ref, text, options?, automatic?} (automatic: the call names that automatic action), ask-on {} (Request.ask: approves read-only commands as approve-reads, denies qa-h6-deny), ask-off {}, policy {spec}, policy-off {id}, policies {}, assess {ref, operation, args?} (public-hooks.md §3.7), after-on {type, operation, where?}, after-off {} (§3.4), intercept-pass {type, operation, delayMs?} (an interceptor that lets the call go after delayMs), intercept-off {}, defaults {spec}, defaults-off {id} (§3.8), query {q}, search {text, opts?}, watch {query} (a view; each message to runs as {id: 'watch', type, on, ref}), unwatch {} (§3.2), dock-badge {spec}, dock-off {id}, dock-attention {kind?} (§3.14). Its renderer module shows a status 'R-OK' in the title bar (the renderer realm's ui.status), command {spec}, slash {spec}, control {spec} (their runs to runs), notify {key, spec}, notify-off {key} (§3.14), ask {spec, withdrawAfterMs?} (its result to runs), open-in {spec} (its run to runs) (§3.14).
